body:
Adds `docs/how-a-press-is-answered.md` (144 lines): one press becomes one request, every request is read once between two frames, and the frame after it says what it asked for. Written from what `src/app/requests.cc`, `src/app/screens.cc` and `src/ui` already do, with the three-dot menu followed end to end as the example and how to add one.

`design-doc.md` gains three lines saying where this document stands beside the others — they were previously only linked one at a time from the README.

Documentation only; no code.
title: how a press is answered, written down from the request to the next frame
